challenge_context: Independent proof of concept; Prima Mente atlas planned for Spring 2027
form_answer: I’d like to test whether reducing CLEC5A in human stem-cell-derived microglia improves amyloid-β clearance without increasing synapse loss. In an independent proof of concept using public SEA-AD data, our trained generative model and donor-level analyses prioritize CLEC5A as a pathology-associated candidate. Published mouse knockout results motivate testing whether the benefit translates to human cells, including across APOE3 and APOE4 backgrounds.

PPARG.units: Per-cell log1p(panel CP10k); equal observed-donor weights.
limitations: Excess zero counts describe a model discrepancy, not its optimization or biological cause.
